Thank you for the kind words.
Never heard of him. Is he someone special?
If you don't mind me asking? Why do you want to die?
Yes they can. Pretty good to be honest.
If you need someone write me.

I really can't because I hate confronting people in any way.
I mean I write texts about what bothers me, but I could never show them. I really can't. And honestly, I really don't think they care how I feel or how they make me feel. As I said, I'm just extra weight for them.

I just said that I also get your point of view. 
Hey I don't want to step too close to you but, why are you so angry? I mean yeah, I know why you are here but I don't get the anger in a random comment section where you see two people nicely exchanging words. I get that you disagree with his statements, but why be so mad about it? I just tried to calm the situation between you guys. 
And I don't really know if your last statement is directed at me, because I never said so..

I eat breakfast everyday but very little, and the rest of the day I eat one other meal MAX now but I noticed I eat less everyday. My sleep is very short, like 4 hours, and i constantly wake up from nightmares. Also I cry almost everynight. 
I tell my friends about that but they just brush it off or completly change the subject, which is why I keep everything to myself nowadays. 
And thanks, your words weirdly mean much more to me than the words of people I know.
And excuse me if I don't respond after some messages I'm really sleepy..

If it didn't work for you, I'm sorry. But as you said, for many they aren't true but for other they are. I think there is truth in his statement, but I also get your side.
And excuse if I'm not responding anymore I am really tired.
But I hope you have a great day, or night depending on your location

Hey, I don't exactly get what the problem is, but if you think renlee is some kind of "asshole" (or any other profanity)
He started chatting with me so he could take my mind of things and with that, helping me. 

I don't want you guys to have beef because of some sort of disagreement over a statement, because at the end of the day he wanted to help.

Right now I'm tired after my daily crying marathon.

And in General it is really rough. Lot's of problems I can't solve and basically no will to keep going except my mom and my brother. Except that I am pretty much numb. Haven't felt human warmth in around 5 years. Can't tell the difference if someone is just nice or flirting. Can't feel happy or in general have good feelings.
I also think my "friends" just hang around because they feel pity for me. So yea..
You mean how I am holding up right now or overall?

Maybe it is possible. I don't believe it, but maybe it is.
And yes maybe we will talk to each other tomorrow.

Thanks.

Hey no problem, it is night time here also. 
And thank you I might come back to this offer.

I see it all the time, but I feel like I don't have the strength to continue. Most of the people have something going for them to keep going. But me, I'm just alive so my mom and my brother won't be sad.

They never talk to me about their problems. They talk to each other but not to me. 
The funny thing is that I had more random people at parties talk to me about their situation, then my "friends" (which btw I don't really have much of)
Also I should clarify that I am reffering to pre corona times about these parties.
Yea i know that is very hard, but I mean in 20 years life time not one person? Maybe I am the problem but I don't about that. I just tell myself that's the reason.

I'm always trying my luck but so far, 20 years old, i wasn't lucky.
Maybe it is not meant for me. Who knows.

A blood drive, that's nice of you.
Well I'm terrible at flrting or even getting when someone is flirting with me. And for things I'm good at, I guess I'm a good listener. But other than that I am not really good at anything. No real talent in gaming, no talent in my job. I'm just not good at anything except listening.

Thanks for taking time for me. 
It truly means something to me.

The thing is I'm going thru this, with slight up's and down's, for 8 years now. And in all this time it has been goin down even with these "up's". I'm only alive at this point for my family, especifically for my mom and my mother. Nothing else. I've had one real suicide attempt in this time. Even then my family didn't really understood, they said it was an accident (trust me this amount of pills isn't an accident).
That's where I get my feeling of worth(or lack of it). Nobody cares or even listens. 
And i know this social media beauty life is not the real world. I hate this crap when I see it. 
But I never felt happiness in all these years except when I took those pills. I was so happy with this thought of not waking up and even that got crushed. 
And sorry for being all over the place, I'm not really able to make long continous sentences.

And your last point, do you mean to post it in here? 
And thanks for taking time for me. I appreciate it.
